name: gn-silvicultura
description: GN — App de gestão de produção em silvicultura (web + mobile-first)

scripts.apk:build:debug: JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" npm run apk:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:build:sim: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.db:reset: echo 'Rode lib/db/schema.sql e lib/db/seed.sql no SQL editor do Supabase'
